description: This file implements the CloudStore class, including initialization, deinitialization, and configuration management for a cloud storage plugin within the WPEFramework. It manages external dependencies, service registration, and environment setup.

classes.name: CloudStore
classes.description: A class managing cloud storage plugin lifecycle, configuration, and environment setup within WPEFramework.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the CloudStore plugin, sets environment variables, creates tokens, registers services, and configures the store.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters services, and releases connections for the CloudStore plugin.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string (currently empty).
